# Volume 5 timeline

## CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — On a spring evening at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) sit on the veranda with sleeping children [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) while awaiting a visit from [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) chat about being back home after three months in [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), enjoying local gossip and reflecting on neighbors' lives as [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) approaches.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P8](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P16](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0016)_

## CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to welcome her back and catch her up on the local news, particularly regarding the new minister, Mr. Meredith, and his motherless children. They discuss the minister's well-meaning but absent-minded nature, his unruly family, and various church gossip before Miss Cornelia takes her leave.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P7](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P11](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P23](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P54](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0054)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Miss Cornelia discuss Anne's recent trip to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) and her appreciation for [Canada](../codex/places.md#canada) and [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). They talk about [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), who will give music lessons to the twins, and mention that the Fords are traveling to [Japan](../codex/places.md#japan). After Miss Cornelia leaves, [Susan](../character/susan.md) puts [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) to bed while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sits outside enjoying the moonrise over the harbor.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P57](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0057), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P67](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0067), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P71](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0071)_

## CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN

**[Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md)** — [The Blythe](../codex/factions.md#blythes) children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) for an evening picnic. [Jem](../character/jem.md) cooks trout he caught in the brook while Walter, [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md), and Di talk, before they set up their makeshift table for their meal.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P4](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P26](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0026)_

## CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN

**[Carl](../character/carl.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#merediths) children gather in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) graveyard and chat about their lives and local gossip. Drawn by a appetizing smell, they head down into [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and meet the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children, who share their cooked trout. The two families quickly bond and become fast friends while exchanging stories about their lives.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)_

**[Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — The children discuss the [West](../character/west.md) sisters and [Persis Ford](../character/persis-ford.md) while chatting in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). As evening falls, the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) head home to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) while [Jem](../character/jem.md) stops to pick mayflowers for his mother.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P50](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0050), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P58](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0058), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P62](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0062)_

## CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md)** — [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#merediths) children discover [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), a hungry runaway orphan, hiding in a nearby barn loft. After feeding her at the manse, they listen to her tragic backstory and teach her about religious concepts in the graveyard. [Faith](../character/faith.md) lends her clean clothes, and the children take her to [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) before finding her a place to sleep in their garret.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P4](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P87](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0087)_

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) arrange a bed in the garret for Mary, who is anxious about her head's cleanliness and her sleeping arrangements. Later, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) hears Mary crying in the garret and goes to comfort her. After discussing Mary's fear of going back to Mrs. [Wiley](../character/wiley.md) and a brief argument over [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md), the two girls reconcile and fall asleep together.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P93](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0093), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P96](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0096), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P106](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0106), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P127](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0127)_

## CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), Bailey, [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cecilia Meredith](../character/cecilia-meredith.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), Ingleside, [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), Rainbow Valley, [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md)** — [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) settles into life at the manse, attending church in borrowed clothes and taking over housecleaning while refusing to return to school. She forms a bond with the children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), fascinating them with ghost stories and feats while clashing occasionally with [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) and [Faith](../character/faith.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P19](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0019), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030)_

## CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) carries a basket of strawberries to the manse, but [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) frightens her by chasing her with a dried codfish. [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) falls into a mud puddle and is rescued by Miss Cornelia, who takes her home to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside). Afterward, Miss Cornelia, [Susan](../character/susan.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss Mary's mischievous antics and potential matches for the local minister.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P19](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0019)_

## CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md)** — Miss Cornelia investigates Mary Vance's situation, revealing that her abusive former guardian has died. Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where Walter reads mythic stories aloud and speaks solemnly about following the [Pied Piper](../character/pied-piper.md). [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) arrives with the news of Mrs. Wiley's death, prompting Mary to express both relief and anxiety over her uncertain future.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P23](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P39](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0039)_

## CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — After [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) cautions Mr. Meredith about [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), Mr. Meredith speaks kindly to Mary and alleviates her fears. Encouraged by [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) boldly visits [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) to ask if she will adopt Mary. [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) agrees after consulting Marshall, and Mary prepares to move to her new home while sharing her frank thoughts on life and stepmothers with [Una](../character/una-meredith.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P5](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P17](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P42](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0042), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080)_

**[John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) and [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) debate religious matters and the household before Mary warns [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that their father might marry again, leaving [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) terrified of getting a stepmother. Meanwhile, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) stays up all night reading about St. Augustine, briefly reflecting on his late wife Cecelia and his children before going to bed.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P88](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0088)_

## CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE

**[Adella](../character/adella.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md), [Elder Abraham](../character/elder-abraham.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Minnie](../character/minnie.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — While Mr. Meredith and Jerry are away and [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) is bedridden, [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) try to manage the house, attend a empty [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school), and clean the manse the following day. Faith's rug-shaking in the graveyard on Monday leads to local rumors and scandal among churchgoers. Meanwhile, [Carl](../character/carl.md) falls sick, but [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) recovers and the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) return home shortly after.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P10](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P35](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0035), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P43](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0043), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P48](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0048)_

## CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md)** — [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) informs the Meredith and [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children that [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) have caused a scandal by accidentally doing house cleaning on Sunday, having lost track of the days. After realizing their mistake with the day of the week, the group talks about their ideas of heaven before heading home, with [Faith](../character/faith.md) reassuring [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she has a plan to make things right.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P0](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P10](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P23](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P47](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0047)_

## CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) and Walter ride pigs through [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary on a dare, which [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) observe as they drive by. Later at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to discuss Faith's church address and pig-riding escapade, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) defend the children.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE P9](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE P10](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE P16](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE P17](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0017)_

## CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL

**[John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md)** — [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) encounters [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) by a secluded, sacred spring in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where he makes her a birch-bark cup to drink from. They walk back to her home together, conversing easily, and Mr. Meredith goes inside to borrow a book. After discussing European politics with [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) and taking his leave, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) accuses [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) of being courted by the minister.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P12](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P19](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0019), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P31](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0031)_

**[Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md)** — [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) and John discuss European politics and [German](../codex/factions.md#german) militarism before John leaves. Afterward, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) warns [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) that John seems interested in courting her, reminding her of a promise she made. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) is irritated by the warning and retires to her room feeling unsettled as autumn begins.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P30](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0030), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P31](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P38](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0038), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P41](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0041)_

## CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cecilia Meredith](../character/cecilia-meredith.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) becomes deeply absorbed in studying [German](../codex/factions.md#german) theology, resulting in complete distraction from his pastoral and domestic duties. Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md) arrives at the manse and abruptly demands to adopt [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), which Mr. Meredith firmly refuses. Outraged, Mrs. [Davis](../character/davis.md) berates him for neglecting his children, leaving him shaken and reflecting on how to properly care for his family.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P0](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P15](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P21](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0021), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P28](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0028)_

**[Carl](../character/carl.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) observes his children during a poor supper and wonders about their reputedly bad behavior. Afterwards, noticing Mrs. Blythe is away, he decides to visit the [West](../character/west.md) homestead in search of comfort and to return a borrowed book.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P38](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0038), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P39](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0039)_

## CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP

## CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Wilson](../character/wilson.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) walks with [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) and hears about his toothache before encountering [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md), who hurls insults at her. She then visits [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) to urge him to return to church and support the minister's salary. After initially fleeing his fierce reaction, [Faith](../character/faith.md) returns in anger to confront him, which amuses Douglas enough to apologize and accept her bargain.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P23](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. After sharing a meal and animated conversation, he drives her home with gifts and produce, leaving [Faith](../character/faith.md) relieved that her father's position in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary is secure.

**[Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Shakespeare](../character/shakespeare.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md)** — After [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) confronts him and agrees to a fight the next evening. Despite his dread, Walter wins the battle after school, defending [Faith](../character/faith.md) and his mother. On his way home through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), he meets Mr. Meredith, who approves of his fighting for a good cause, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later comforts him after hearing what happened.

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Perry](../character/perry.md), [Taylor](../character/taylor.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Wilson](../character/wilson.md)** — [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) meets [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md), Di, [Faith](../character/faith.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), boasting about her new clothes and squirrel-fur muff. After Mary leaves, [Jem](../character/jem.md) joins the children and suggests they form a [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) to discipline themselves. Inspired by Jem's advice, [Faith](../character/faith.md), Jerry, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Carl](../character/carl.md) agree to form the club to manage their own conduct.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P3](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P33](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0033), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. Afterward, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) expresses her fears to [Faith](../character/faith.md) about the rumors that their father might marry Miss West, worried that stepmothers become cruel and turn fathers against their children.

## CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Lida Marsh](../character/lida-marsh.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) gives her shoes and good stockings to a cold, barefoot girl named [Lida Marsh](../character/lida-marsh.md), only to realize afterwards that her only remaining option for Sunday church is a hideous pair of striped stockings. Refusing to wear them or fake an illness, [Faith](../character/faith.md) stands on a snowbank trying to catch a cold so she can legitimately stay home. Jerry and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) forcibly pull [Faith](../character/faith.md) off the snow while passing townspeople overhear their noisy argument.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P11](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P21](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0021), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. ## CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) causes a scandal in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary by attending church without stockings, sparking community gossip and concern among [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) and Miss Cornelia. In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the other children discuss the incident, and Jerry punishes [Faith](../character/faith.md) via the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) by making her wear her hated striped stockings. To clear her father of any blame, [Faith](../character/faith.md) writes a detailed letter of explanation to the local newspaper.

## CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE

**[Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md)** — The children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to read and talk about their future plans. [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) arrives thoroughly startled and tells them the story of Henry Warren's ghost haunting the nearby [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden. After cooking and eating dinner together, the children disperse, with the [Merediths](../codex/factions.md#merediths) nervously heading home alone while avoiding the haunted garden.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P9](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P14](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0014)_

## CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) at dusk, [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) mistake Mrs. [Stimson](../character/stimson.md) hunting for a lost knitting needle under a sheet for the ghost of [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md) and flee in panic. Running to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), they report their terror to [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md). [Susan](../character/susan.md) investigates with a pitchfork and returns with the embarrassing truth, leaving the children deeply mortified.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P3](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P8](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P14](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P25](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0025)_

## CHAPTER XXXI. CARL DOES PENANCE

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md)** — Jerry decrees punishments for his siblings' cowardice, ordering [Carl](../character/carl.md) to sit alone in the graveyard until midnight. [Carl](../character/carl.md) bravely completes the ordeal in a chilling rainstorm, but comes down with severe pneumonia as a result. After fighting through a dangerous crisis with Dr. Blythe's care, [Carl](../character/carl.md) recovers and is welcomed back by his friends and family.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. CARL DOES PENANCE P8](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. CARL DOES PENANCE P22](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. CARL DOES PENANCE P26](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0026), [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. CARL DOES PENANCE P27](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0027)_

## CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE

**[Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md)** — [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) confronts [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), asking her to release [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) from her past promise so they can marry, to which [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) agrees. When [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) returns home and informs [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md), [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) feels remorseful and tries to suggest contacting [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md). However, when [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) refuses to move in with Norman and [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md), [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) declares she will not leave [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) alone and refuses to marry Norman.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P13](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0013), [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P22](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P41](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0041)_

## CHAPTER XXXIII. CARL IS—NOT—WHIPPED

**[Carl](../character/carl.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) tells [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) gossip about why [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) rejected their father and accuses [Carl](../character/carl.md) of putting an eel in Mrs. Carr's buggy. After learning about Carl's prank, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) decides to whip him, but breaks down and refuses to go through with the punishment when he looks into Carl's eyes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXXIII. CARL IS—NOT—WHIPPED P2](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIII. CARL IS—NOT—WHIPPED P9](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIII. CARL IS—NOT—WHIPPED P12](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIII. CARL IS—NOT—WHIPPED P30](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0030)_

## CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL

**[Carl](../character/carl.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), Blythes, [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Adam](../character/adam.md)** — [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) visits [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) to ask her to marry her father, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), willing to risk having a stepmother for her father's happiness. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reassures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she will be a friend rather than a cruel stepmother and gives her a note for her father, which restores John Meredith's spirits upon receiving it.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL P24](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0024), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL P44](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0044)_

## CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di Blythe](../character/di-blythe.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md)** — In the evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss the upcoming double wedding and the arrangements for the children while the newlyweds are away. Meanwhile, in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the children gather on Jem's last evening before he leaves for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Walter and [Jem](../character/jem.md) speak of battles and following the Pied Piper's call into the future.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P1](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P16](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P20](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0020)_
